# Generated .NET finalizer ordering repro

This branch leaves the .NET backend unchanged. It adds:

* a Rust owned-borrowing feature fixture in
  `feature_tests/src/dotnet_finalizer_order.rs`; and
* a C# feature test that uses the bindings generated by the existing backend.

The generated dependent wrapper contains its normal strong `_edges` reference
to the source. The test never calls `Dispose` on either wrapper. It creates
100,000 source/dependent pairs and forces finalization. The dependent Rust
`Drop` reads through its source borrow after recording whether the source
already dropped.

Generate and run:

```powershell
cargo make gen-dotnet-feature
cargo make test-dotnet
```

Run only the repro repeatedly:

```powershell
cd feature_tests\dotnet
dotnet test Somelib.FeatureTests.csproj --no-restore --nologo `
  --filter FullyQualifiedName~GeneratedEdges_DoNotGuaranteeOwnedBorrowingFinalizerOrder
```

Observed on the first full run:

```text
Fatal error.
0xC0000005
   at Somelib.Raw.FinalizerOrderDependent.Destroy(...)
   at Somelib.Diplomat.RustHandle`1.Release()
   at Somelib.FinalizerOrderDependent.Dispose()
   at Somelib.FinalizerOrderDependent.Finalize()
```

The access violation occurs in the generated dependent finalizer when Rust
`Drop` reads the already-freed source. This is the concrete UAF that the
managed `_edges` reference does not order away.
